302:
SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE LOWER(a."element")
        WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'
        WHEN 'c'  THEN 'Carbon'
        WHEN 'h'  THEN 'Hydrogen'
        WHEN 'o'  THEN 'Oxygen'
        WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'
        WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
        WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus'
        WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
        WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
        WHEN 'f'  THEN 'Fluorine'
        WHEN 'i'  THEN 'Iodine'
        WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
        WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
        WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
        WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
        ELSE a."element"
    END AS element
FROM "connected" c
JOIN "atom" a
    ON a."atom_id" = c."atom_id"
    OR a."atom_id" = c."atom_id2"
WHERE c."bond_id" = 'TR001_2_4'
ORDER BY element ASC NULLS FIRST;

    ON p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics'
WHERE s."height_cm" BETWEEN 150 AND 180;
775:
SELECT
    
    SUM(CASE WHEN c."colour" = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
    / COUNT(*)::NUMERIC * 100 AS percentage
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "gender" g ON s."gender_id" = g."id"
JOIN "colour" c ON s."skin_colour_id" = c."id"
WHERE g."gender" = 'Female'
743:
WITH total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(s."id") AS total_count
    FROM "superhero" s
),

bad_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(s."id") AS bad_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 END) AS bad_marvel_count
    FROM "superhero" s
    JOIN "alignment" a ON s."alignment_id" = a."id"
    LEFT JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
    WHERE a."alignment" = 'Bad'
)

SELECT
    (bs.bad_count::NUMERIC / t.total_count) * 100 AS bad_percentage,
    bs.bad_marvel_count AS marvel_bad_count
FROM total t
CROSS JOIN bad_stats bs;
724:
SELECT s."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" ec ON s."eye_colour_id" = ec."id"
JOIN "colour" hc ON s."hair_colour_id" = hc."id"
WHERE ec."colour" = 'Blue'
  AND hc."colour" = 'Blond';
829:
SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN s."id" END)
    - COUNT(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN s."id" END) AS difference
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');
744:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics');
772:
SELECT
    ec."colour" AS eye_colour,
    hc."colour" AS hair_colour,
    sc."colour" AS skin_colour
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "gender" g
    ON s."gender_id" = g."id"
JOIN "publisher" p
    ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
JOIN "colour" ec
    ON s."eye_colour_id" = ec."id"
JOIN "colour" hc
    ON s."hair_colour_id" = hc."id"
JOIN "colour" sc
    ON s."skin_colour_id" = sc."id"
WHERE g."gender" = 'Female'
  AND p."publisher_name" = 'Dark Horse Comics';
834:
SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN g."gender" = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS female_percentage
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
JOIN "gender" g ON s."gender_id" = g."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" LIKE '%George Lucas%';
819:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN c."id" = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN c."id" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" c ON s."eye_colour_id" = c."id"
WHERE s."weight_kg" = 0 OR s."weight_kg" IS NULL;
773:
SELECT
    s."superhero_name",
    p."publisher_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE s."eye_colour_id" = s."hair_colour_id"
  AND s."hair_colour_id" = s."skin_colour_id";
1342:
SELECT SUM(e."cost") AS total_cost
FROM "event" ev
JOIN "budget" b ON b."link_to_event" = ev."event_id"
JOIN "expense" e ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
WHERE ev."event_date" = '2019-09-04'
  AND (ev."notes" LIKE '%Poster%' OR ev."type" LIKE '%Poster%' OR ev."event_name" LIKE '%Poster%');
1349:
SELECT SUM(b."amount") AS total_budget_amount
FROM "event" e
JOIN "budget" b ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE e."event_name" LIKE '%September Speaker%';
1447:
SELECT DISTINCT
    e."event_name",
    e."location"
FROM "budget" b
JOIN "event" e
    ON e."event_id" = b."link_to_event"
WHERE b."remaining" > 0
ORDER BY e."event_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, e."location" ASC NULLS FIRST;
1462:
SELECT
    b."category",
    b."amount"
FROM "budget" b
JOIN "event" e ON e."event_id" = b."link_to_event"
WHERE e."event_name" LIKE '%January Speaker%';
1394:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
WHERE mj."major_name" LIKE '%Physics Teaching%';
1385:
SELECT DISTINCT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name"
FROM "income" i
JOIN "member" m
    ON m."member_id" = i."link_to_member"
WHERE i."amount" > 40
ORDER BY m."first_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, m."last_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
1436:
WITH big_spenders AS (
    SELECT e."link_to_member" AS member_id
    FROM "expense" e
    GROUP BY e."link_to_member"
    HAVING SUM(e."cost") > 50
)

SELECT DISTINCT a."link_to_event" AS event_link
FROM "attendance" a
JOIN big_spenders bs ON bs.member_id = a."link_to_member"
JOIN "event" ev ON ev."event_id" = a."link_to_event";
1420:
SELECT DISTINCT m."major_name"
FROM "member" mem
JOIN "major" m ON m."major_id" = mem."link_to_major"
WHERE mem."position" LIKE '%Vice President%';
1468:
SELECT zc."city"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "zip_code" zc ON zc."zip_code" = m."zip"
WHERE m."first_name" LIKE 'Garrett%'
  AND m."last_name" LIKE 'Gerke%';
1328:
SELECT m."last_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
WHERE mj."major_name" LIKE '%Law and Constitutional Studies%';
1365:
SELECT e."expense_description"
FROM "expense" e
WHERE e."link_to_budget" = (
    SELECT b."budget_id"
    FROM "budget" b
    ORDER BY b."remaining" ASC NULLS FIRST
    LIMIT 1
);
1388:
SELECT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    i."source"
FROM "income" i
JOIN "member" m ON i."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE i."amount" = (SELECT MAX("amount") FROM "income")
ORDER BY i."amount" DESC NULLS LAST;
1426:
SELECT
    m."last_name",
    mj."department",
    mj."college"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj
    ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
WHERE mj."major_name" LIKE '%Environmental Engineering%'
ORDER BY m."last_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
1456:
SELECT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    SUM(e."cost") AS total_spent
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "member" m ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
GROUP BY m."member_id", m."first_name", m."last_name"
ORDER BY total_spent DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;
1453:
WITH avg_parking AS (
    SELECT SUM(e."cost") / COUNT(DISTINCT b."link_to_event") AS avg_cost
    FROM "expense" e
    JOIN "budget" b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
    WHERE b."category" = 'Parking'
),

event_parking AS (
    SELECT ev."event_name" AS event_name,
           SUM(e."cost") AS parking_cost
    FROM "event" ev
    JOIN "budget" b ON b."link_to_event" = ev."event_id"
    JOIN "expense" e ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
    WHERE b."category" = 'Parking'
    GROUP BY ev."event_name"
)

SELECT ep.event_name
FROM event_parking ep
CROSS JOIN avg_parking ap
WHERE ep.parking_cost < ap.avg_cost
1439:
SELECT m."phone"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
WHERE mj."major_name" LIKE '%Business%'
  AND mj."college" LIKE '%College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences%';
1428:
SELECT DISTINCT
    zc."city",
    zc."state"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj
    ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"

1323:
SELECT e."event_name"

WHERE e."type" NOT LIKE '%fundraiser%'
GROUP BY e."event_id", e."event_name"
HAVING COUNT(a."link_to_event") > 20

1449:

    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    mj."major_name"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "member" m ON m."member_id" = e."link_to_member"
JOIN "major" mj ON mj."major_id" = m."link_to_major"
WHERE e."cost" > 100
1340:
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(e."event_date", 4) = '2019' THEN b."spent" END), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LEFT(e."event_date", 4) = '2020' THEN b."spent" END), 0) AS difference
FROM "budget" b
JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE LEFT(e."event_date", 4) IN ('2019', '2020');
1399:
SELECT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    e."event_name",
    CASE WHEN a."link_to_member" IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS attended
FROM "member" m
CROSS JOIN "event" e
LEFT JOIN "attendance" a
    ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
   AND a."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE m."first_name" LIKE 'Maya'
  AND m."last_name" LIKE 'Mclean'
  AND e."event_name" LIKE '%Women%s Soccer%';
1401:
SELECT e."cost"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "budget" b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
JOIN "event" ev ON b."link_to_event" = ev."event_id"
WHERE ev."event_name" LIKE '%September Speaker%'
  AND e."expense_description" LIKE '%Posters%';
1431:
SELECT DISTINCT m."last_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "event" e ON e."event_id" = a."link_to_event"
WHERE m."position" = 'Member'
  AND e."event_name" LIKE '%Women%s Soccer%'
ORDER BY m."last_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
1339:
SELECT AVG(e."cost") AS avg_cost
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "member" m ON m."member_id" = e."link_to_member"
WHERE m."first_name" LIKE 'Elijah'
  AND m."last_name" LIKE 'Allen'
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e."expense_date") IN (9, 10);
1359:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
    /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" = 'October Meeting' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END), 0)::NUMERIC
    AS ratio
FROM "budget" b
JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE b."category" = 'Advertisement'
  AND e."event_name" IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting');
1429:
SELECT DISTINCT e."event_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "event" e ON e."event_id" = a."link_to_event"
WHERE m."position" LIKE '%Vice President%'
  AND e."type" = 'Social'
  AND e."location" LIKE '%900 E. Washington St.%';
1437:
SELECT DISTINCT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.email,
    e.event_name,
    a.link_to_event
FROM "expense" ex
JOIN "member" m
    ON m.member_id = ex.link_to_member
JOIN "attendance" a
    ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN "event" e
    ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE ex.approved = 'true'
  AND ex.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19'
ORDER BY m.first_name ASC NULLS FIRST, m.last_name ASC NULLS FIRST;
1448:
SELECT DISTINCT
    e."event_name",
    e."event_date"
FROM "expense" ex
JOIN "budget" b ON ex."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE ex."expense_description" = 'Pizza'
  AND ex."cost" > 50
  AND ex."cost" < 100
ORDER BY e."event_date" ASC NULLS FIRST;
1451:
WITH multi_event_members AS (
    SELECT e."link_to_member" AS member_id
    FROM "expense" e
    JOIN "budget" b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
    GROUP BY e."link_to_member"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b."link_to_event") > 1
),

max_cost AS (
    SELECT MAX(e."cost") AS max_cost
    FROM "expense" e
    JOIN multi_event_members m ON e."link_to_member" = m.member_id
)

SELECT mem."first_name", mem."last_name"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN multi_event_members m ON e."link_to_member" = m.member_id
JOIN max_cost mc ON e."cost" = mc.max_cost
JOIN "member" mem ON mem."member_id" = e."link_to_member"
1457:
WITH avg_cost AS (
    SELECT AVG(cost) AS avg_cost
    FROM "expense"
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    m."phone"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "member" m
    ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
CROSS JOIN avg_cost a
WHERE e."cost" > a.avg_cost
1460:

    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    e."cost"

JOIN "member" m

    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    i."amount"

    ON i."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
